info.title: notify
info.description: Cross-platform desktop notifications + ntfy.sh push notifications.

options.name: --no-ntfy
options.description: Suppress ntfy even if env var is set

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit non-zero if any configured backend fails (default: best-effort)

options.name: --icon
options.description: Icon path (best-effort per backend; macOS ignores)

options.name: --ntfy
options.description: Send to ntfy.sh on TOPIC (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_TOPIC)

options.name: --ntfy-server
options.description: Override ntfy server URL (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_SERVER, default https://ntfy.sh)

options.name: --ntfy-token
options.description: Bearer token for self-hosted ntfy (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_TOKEN)

options.name: --describe
options.description:
Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
Exit Codes:
0    Success — at least one backend succeeded
1    Strict mode — at least one configured backend failed
125  Usage error: bad flags, missing TITLE, no backends configured
126  All backends failed
